Name: Official Xbox Magazine: Volume 115: November 2010
Overview:
Official Xbox Magazine (OXM) Demo Disc #115 shipped to subscribers in September 2010 (bearing the cover date of November 2010 for Issue 115). Formatted natively for Xbox 360 hardware, Disc #115 featured high-definition 360 playable game demos, Xbox Live Arcade (XLA) trials, custom downloadable content, and exclusive media previews:

Mafia II (open-world action-adventure)
FIFA 11 (sports simulation)
NBA 2K11 (sports simulation)
Plants vs. Zombies (Xbox Live Arcade tower defense strategy)
Swarm (Xbox Live Arcade action-puzzle platformer)
Hydrophobia (Xbox Live Arcade survival action-adventure)

In addition to interactive gameplay, the native 360 disc included downloadable Plants vs. Zombies gamerpics, offline backward-compatibility emulation updates, and high-definition 720p/1080i video previews--featuring coverage for Halo: Reach, Metal Gear Solid: Rising, Red Faction: Armageddon, Castlevania: Lords of Shadow, and Children of Eden, alongside OXM's monthly Review Roundup and Top Plays segment.
